```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

# Pipeline and model

```{r pipeline}
# Run the code of the pipeline chunk directly. knitr::purl() cannot be used
# here: it is itself a knit, and inside this knit it clashes with our chunk
# labels (both files have a 'setup' chunk).
lines <- readLines("rossmann_stages2_4.Rmd")
start <- grep("^```\\{r pipeline", lines)[1]
end   <- start + which(grepl("^```\\s*$", lines[(start + 1):length(lines)]))[1]
eval(parse(text = lines[(start + 1):(end - 1)]), envir = globalenv())

sp   <- split_window(df, FEAT_S1, max(df$Date), months = 6)
X_te <- sp$X_test; Xtr <- sp$X_train

# A saved booster can only be used by the xgboost version that saved it
# (3.x boosters read under 1.7 come back as a plain list). The saved model is
# used only if it predicts; otherwise the model is fitted again and saved.
MODEL_RDS <- "xgb_6m_model.rds"
model <- if (file.exists(MODEL_RDS)) tryCatch(readRDS(MODEL_RDS), error = function(e) NULL) else NULL
model_loaded <- inherits(model, "xgb.Booster") &&
  !is.null(tryCatch(predict(model, xgb.DMatrix(X_te[1:2, , drop = FALSE])), error = function(e) NULL))
if (!model_loaded) {
  model <- run_xgboost(sp, return_model = TRUE)$model
  saveRDS(model, MODEL_RDS)
}
c(xgboost = as.character(packageVersion("xgboost")), model_loaded = model_loaded)
```

```{r helpers}
bm   <- run_store_mean(sp)$RMSE
gain <- function(pred) delta_rel(bm, eval_metrics(sp$y_test, pred)$RMSE)
pred_with <- function(col, value) { X <- X_te; X[, col] <- value; predict(model, xgb.DMatrix(X)) }
p0 <- predict(model, xgb.DMatrix(X_te))
```

# 1. Level of the forecasts

```{r level}
sm   <- tapply(sp$y_train, sp$train$Store, mean)
p_sm <- sm[as.character(X_te[, "Store"])]
sb   <- tapply(p0 - sp$y_test, X_te[, "Store"], mean)
pr0  <- X_te[, "Promo"] == 0
level <- tibble(
  gain_orig        = gain(p0),
  actual_mean      = mean(sp$y_test),
  xgb_pred_mean    = mean(p0),
  xgb_bias         = mean(p0 - sp$y_test),
  storemean_bias   = mean(p_sm - sp$y_test),
  share_stores_over = mean(sb > 0),
  bias_promo0      = mean(p0[pr0] - sp$y_test[pr0]),
  bias_promo1      = mean(p0[!pr0] - sp$y_test[!pr0]),
  train_bias_max   = max(abs(tapply(predict(model, xgb.DMatrix(Xtr)) - sp$y_train, Xtr[, "Month"], mean))))
level
```

# 2. Which input carries the shift (SHAP)

Mean SHAP contribution on 5000 test rows minus that on 5000 training rows from
the last two training months (May-June).

```{r shap}
set.seed(1)
last <- which(Xtr[, "Month"] %in% c(5, 6))
i_te <- sample(nrow(X_te), 5000); i_tr <- sample(last, 5000)
c_te <- predict(model, xgb.DMatrix(X_te[i_te, ]), predcontrib = TRUE)
c_tr <- predict(model, xgb.DMatrix(Xtr[i_tr, ]),  predcontrib = TRUE)
shap_diff <- sort(colMeans(c_te) - colMeans(c_tr), decreasing = TRUE)
round(shap_diff)
```

# 3. Week: unseen test weeks and the last training week

The training window has ISO weeks 1 to `r max(Xtr[Xtr[, "Week"] < 40, "Week"])`
and the December weeks; the test weeks are
`r min(X_te[, "Week"])` to `r max(X_te[, "Week"])`. A tree split on Week can
only fall at a value seen in training, so every test week goes to the same
branch as the last training week in every tree.

```{r week}
last_wk <- max(Xtr[Xtr[, "Week"] < 40, "Week"])
wk_tab <- tibble(Week = sort(unique(Xtr[, "Week"]))) %>%
  mutate(days        = sapply(Week, function(w) n_distinct(sp$train$Date[Xtr[, "Week"] == w])),
         promo_share = sapply(Week, function(w) mean(Xtr[Xtr[, "Week"] == w, "Promo"])),
         mean_sales  = sapply(Week, function(w) mean(sp$y_train[Xtr[, "Week"] == w])))
wk_tab %>% filter(Week >= last_wk - 3)

tr_dt <- xgb.model.dt.tree(model = model)
n_split_last <- sum(tr_dt$Feature == "Week" & tr_dt$Split == last_wk, na.rm = TRUE)

cf <- map_dfr(c(last_wk, 20, 23, last_wk - 1), function(w) {
  p <- pred_with("Week", w); tibble(Week = w, pred_mean = mean(p), gain = gain(p)) })
cf
```

# Output for the thesis

```{r write}
w_last <- wk_tab %>% filter(Week == last_wk); w_prev <- wk_tab %>% filter(Week == last_wk - 1)
cf_prev <- cf %>% filter(Week == last_wk - 1)
diag <- level %>% mutate(
  xgboost_version   = as.character(packageVersion("xgboost")),
  model_loaded      = model_loaded,
  test_week_min     = min(X_te[, "Week"]), test_week_max = max(X_te[, "Week"]),
  last_train_week   = last_wk,
  last_week_days    = w_last$days,  last_week_promo_share = w_last$promo_share,
  last_week_sales   = w_last$mean_sales, prev_week_sales = w_prev$mean_sales,
  prev_week_promo_share = w_prev$promo_share,
  n_split_last_week = n_split_last,
  shap_week = unname(shap_diff["Week"]), shap_total = sum(shap_diff),
  cf_week_prev_pred_mean = cf_prev$pred_mean, cf_week_prev_gain = cf_prev$gain,
  cf_week_min_gain  = min(cf$gain[cf$Week != last_wk]),
  cf_week_max_gain  = max(cf$gain[cf$Week != last_wk])) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 3)))
t(diag)
# Written for the thesis: Section 4.3.2 six-month paragraph. Do not edit the CSV.
dir.create("thesis_tables", showWarnings = FALSE)
write_csv(diag, "thesis_tables/stage2_window_diag.csv")
```
